records.what_it_shows: The model executed the supplied reproducer first, inspected the client-cache helpers, added synchronous and asynchronous initialization regression tests, and ran those tests. Workflow budget reached; inspect the retained trace for progress and submitted changes.

The model reproduced the bug, wrote two regression tests with the file-writing tool, verified both failed, then edited the client helper. The run stopped at twenty calls before further repair or final submission.
